description: This file defines classes and methods for manufacturing resource planning (MRP) in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including workcenters, routing, bills of materials, production orders, procurement, and stock moves.

classes.name: mrp_workcenter
classes.description: Represents a workcenter used in manufacturing, with properties like name, type, capacity, times, and costs.

classes.name: mrp_property
classes.description: Defines properties that can be associated with bills of materials or other entities.

classes.name: mrp_routing
classes.description: Defines a routing for manufacturing, including associated workcenters.

classes.name: mrp_routing_workcenter
classes.description: Associates workcenters with routing steps, including sequence and cycle info.

classes.name: mrp_bom
classes.description: Represents a bill of materials, including components, routing, and hierarchy.

classes.name: mrp_bom_revision
classes.description: Tracks revisions of bills of materials.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Manages manufacturing orders, including product, routing, stock moves, and state transitions.

classes.name: mrp_production_workcenter_line
classes.description: Details work orders within a production, including workcenter, cycles, and hours.

classes.name: mrp_production_product_line
classes.description: Lists products scheduled for production with quantities and UOM.

classes.name: mrp_procurement
classes.description: Handles procurement processes: produce, buy, or find products, including reservations and moves.

classes.name: stock_warehouse_orderpoint
classes.description: Defines minimum stock rules for products in warehouses.

classes.name: StockMove
classes.description: Extends stock move with procurement references and explode logic.

classes.name: StockPicking
classes.description: Extends stock picking with methods for exploding phantom BoMs and validation.

methods.name: _compute_type
methods.description: Determines BOM type based on supply and procure methods.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates UOM and name when product changes.

methods.name: _bom_find
methods.description: Finds a BOM matching product, UOM, and properties.

methods.name: _bom_explode
methods.description: Recursively explodes BOM into components and routing steps.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive BOMs to prevent infinite loops.

methods.name: action_compute
methods.description: Computes BOM components and routing for a production order.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels production and related stock moves.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Completes production, updates stock moves, and records costs.

methods.name: action_in_production
methods.description: Marks production as in progress and confirms moves.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Confirms production, creates stock moves, and reservations.

methods.name: force_production
methods.description: Forces assignment of stock moves for production.

methods.name: _action_explode
methods.description: Explodes a stock move with phantom BOMs into sub-moves and procurements.
